doc.title: Jonathan Scales interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 23, 2025

title: Being present and leaning into the people who love the band
summary: He wants to stay present and follow the audience that loves them rather than closed festivals and venues.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: So like that’s like who knows what’s going to happen – who knows where things are going? So like I said I’m a big studier of like philosophy and things like that and right now I think that my job is just to be present and to just make the most of everything that’s happening just like right in front of me, not worry too much about the past, not worry too much about the future, not worry too much about like all the work that it took to get here, and not worry about the people who aren’t allowing us to go through those doors. You know like I could name so many names of venues and festivals and things like that that won’t give us the time of day. There’s things that people don’t understand still, is they see something we’re doing and they’re not understanding the things, the roadblocks that are still there for us because you know right now it’s important to go where the love is. That’s way more important than trying to break through this door and get to this venue or this festival. You know what I’m saying? Like I’ve been able to make a sustainable career from people who genuinely love what we do and they come out to see us. You know that’s not attached to any venue or any festival. We built that. So like I think right now is the time where like man we’re leaning into that like there are a lot of my colleagues are part of events and festivals that we aren’t even in the conversation for. And although those would be great, I’m also realizing that that doesn’t stop us from continuing with our journey as a band and really leaning into the people who love us. So I thank you for including me in the series, and I don’t take it lightly. It’s a big deal for me.
Yeah for me too. It has been a fabulous conversation. I think you could also add to your list of the things you are is like a motivational speaker.
